exportUsers.description:
Minimum role: Tenant Administrator.

Downloads all users in the tenant as a CSV file. Columns: `username`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `licenses`. Use `Limit` and `Offset` to page through large tenants.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Number of rows to skip before returning results.

exportUsers.response_note: no documented 2xx JSON response schema — probe a read operation to learn it

importUsers.description:
Minimum role: Tenant Administrator.

Bulk-creates or updates users by uploading a CSV file. Users are matched by `username` (email address). Existing users are updated, and new addresses are created.

CSV columns: `username`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `licenses`. Constraints: at least one data row, no more than 500 rows, no duplicate email addresses, no empty cells. Licenses must be quoted and comma-separated when a user holds more than one.

Returns 207 Multi-Status with per-row counts and line-level errors.

file.description: CSV file containing user records to import.

accepted.description: Total number of data rows found in the CSV (excluding the header).

created.description: Number of rows that resulted in a new user being created.

updated.description: Number of rows that resulted in an existing user being updated.

errors.description: Line-level validation errors. Empty when all rows were accepted.

line.description: 1-based line number in the CSV (excluding the header row) where the error occurred.

message.description: Human-readable description of why the row was rejected.
